description: PHP source file that implements JWT token verification including signature validation, token data validation, and key management, with functions for logging and handling JWT tokens and public keys.

methods.name: VerifyToken
methods.description: Main function to verify a JWT token by checking its segments, signature, and token data validity.

methods.name: VerifySignature
methods.description: Verifies the JWT signature using the public key fetched and stored during runtime.

methods.name: CheckModTimeValid
methods.description: Checks if the file modification time is within a valid timeframe.

methods.name: VerifyTokenData
methods.description: Validates claims in the token data such as 'iat', 'nbf', 'exp', and 'tid'.

methods.name: WritePubKey
methods.description: Writes a decoded public key to a file.

methods.name: LogTokenData
methods.description: Logs token or error information to a log file.
